description: JavaScript source file for Leads module in vtiger CRM, including functions for form validation, setting return values, map location search, and UI interactions.

methods.name: verifyConvertLeadData
methods.description: Validates lead conversion form data, checking mandatory fields, email pattern, and transfer options.

methods.name: togglePotFields
methods.description: Enables or disables potential-related form fields based on checkbox state.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Sets parent product info in the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_todo
methods.description: Sets parent product info in the opener window for a to-do item.

methods.name: set_return_specific
methods.description: Sets lead name and ID in the opener window for specific use cases.

methods.name: add_data_to_relatedlist
methods.description: Updates email relations for a lead.

methods.name: submitform
methods.description: Submits a mass delete form with specified entity ID.

methods.name: searchMapLocation
methods.description: Opens Google Maps with address details for location search.

methods.name: selectTransferTo
methods.description: Displays transfer options for Accounts or Contacts.
